description: Department of Forest Conservation - Dambagaha Ulpatha and Ambulgaswewa as Reserved Forests - Dambagaha Uplatha reserved Forest and Ambulgaswewa reserved Forests are subjected to the single control of the Conservator General of Forests
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land matters, specifically the declaration of a specific state land area (561.04 hectares named Dambagaha Ulpatha) as a Reserved Forest. It includes detailed boundary coordinates and land survey information, which falls under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land registrations, land acquisitions, and land use designations. While it mentions a government official (State Minister), the core content is about land designation rather than government personnel or structural changes.
